name: Cyrus Finance
rootCause: The Cyrus Finance CyrusTreasury contract on BSC read the live PancakeSwap V3 pool slot0 spot price — with no TWAP or manipulation-resistant oracle — to determine how much liquidity to remove from its managed concentrated LP positions when exit() / withdrawUSDTFromAny() was called. An attacker flash-borrowed 1,798 ETH, then performed a large ETH→USDT swap that artificially inflated the ETH spot price by crossing 92 price ticks. When exit() executed under the manipulated price, the contract calculated near-zero USDT availability in the position and removed essentially all LP liquidity in the high-ETH-price direction, returning predominantly ETH. The slippage check only protected the USDT component, leaving the ETH value unprotected. After restoring the price via a reverse swap and repaying the flash loan, the attacker extracted approximately $512,000 in ETH and USDT at the expense of the protocol's LP. Attack Tx: 0x2b7efd...d69524 Analysis: PeckShield Alert Cyrus Price Manipulation – DARKNAVY

The DeFi yield protocol Cyrus Finance (CyrusTreasury contract) on BNB Chain was exploited. The attacker used a flash loan to manipulate the PancakeSwap V3 ETH/USDT pool spot price, triggering a vulnerability in the withdrawUSDTFromAny function to over-extract liquidity from an LP position, profiting approximately $516,840 before laundering the funds via Tornado Cash in 9 batches.

Cyrus Finance was exploited on BNB Chain in a flash-loan-enabled price manipulation targeting its PancakeSwap V3 LP-management logic. Losses were approximately $520,000, with attacker proceeds withdrawn as ETH and USDT. The CyrusTreasury contract calculated withdrawal amounts by reading the current block's spot price from PancakeSwap V3's slot0, allowing a flash loan to manipulate the ETH/USDT pool price at withdrawal. Liquidity was removed disproportionately, favoring the attacker.
